policies.B1: Primary capital adequacy requires a corporate deposit of at least $4,000,000.
policies.D1: Corporate onboarding approval is granted to an entity meeting primary capital adequacy that also provides a verified ultimate beneficial owner disclosure.
policies.B2: Standard compliance clearance requires a corporate deposit of at least $3,000,000 along with an audited annual compliance report.
policies.B3: Heightened risk vetting is granted to an entity with standard compliance status that maintains a clean transaction monitoring record of at least 6 months.
policies.D2: Permission for direct exchange connectivity is issued to an entity with heightened risk approval holding an active institutional broker license.
policies.B4: Operational verification is satisfied by an onshore escrow account balance of $1,000,000 or more, or possessing a Level 1 AML certification, or holding a SWIFT BIC code registration.
policies.B5: Prime broker designation is conferred upon an entity meeting operational verification requirements that holds permission for direct exchange connectivity.
policies.D3: Allocation of dedicated liquidity facilities is approved for an entity with prime broker standing.
policies.B6: Secondary risk mitigation is established either with a commercial guarantee of at least $5,000,000 or with a tax residence certificate from an EU jurisdiction.
policies.B7: Eligibility for cross-border settlement is conferred upon an entity meeting auxiliary risk mitigation that has obtained corporate onboarding clearance.
policies.B8: International routing clearance requires holding a SWIFT BIC code registration.
policies.B9: International wire transfer authorization is granted to an entity with international routing clearance that has corporate onboarding approval.
policies.B10: High-volume merchant standing requires a yearly turnover of at least $20,000,000.
policies.B11: Ethics compliance verification requires holding an ISO 37001 anti-bribery certification.
policies.B12: Tier-one credit standing is assigned to an entity possessing a credit rating of AA or higher.
policies.B13: Regulatory staffing adequacy requires maintaining a minimum certified compliance headcount of 3.

decoy_policies: Syndicated loan participation requires maintaining a leverage ratio under 3.5x.
Foreign exchange desk licensing requires maintaining net solvency reserves of at least $15,000,000.
